name: Project 17 - AI Video Repurposing Engine (Viral Clips, Carousel & SEO Blog)

parameters.content:
### 🎥 AI VIDEO REPURPOSING ENGINE
**Triggers:**
1. Webhook: `POST /webhook/video-repurpose`
2. Telegram Command: `/repurpose <youtube_link>` via `@video_repurposer_sk_bot`

**Output Deliverables:**
• 3 High-Retention Viral Moments (Exact Start/End Timestamps, Hooks, Scripts)
• 10-Slide LinkedIn Carousel (Structured JSON & Narrative)
• 1,500-Word SEO Pillar Blog Post
• Telegram Multi-Card Delivery to Admin
